verdict.rationale: An llms.txt exists at tryjeeves.com/llms.txt, but its cited content is marketing-level product summaries (stablecoin payments, Jeeves Cash, expense management, API platform launch), not developer reference. The developer docs site returns 404 for llms.txt, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. MCP documentation exists and is somewhat agent-oriented, but it describes capabilities rather than giving an agent-consumable docs index. Missing for 10: llms.txt on the developer docs site (redocly.app), developer/API-level content in llms.txt, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use of the docs.
